title: I would love to have a Vacmop, But!
text: I would love to have a Vacmop, But!. I really wanted to buy one of these Vacmops. But half the people say Yes! An half the people say No! I'm going with the many No's. I don't have money to throw away. Vacmop People, get it together, you will have a lot if customer's. If you get it together. I've been talking about getting a Vacmop since last summer. Now looking @ the review's. I've changed my mind.
